_comment: A REAL Facet KYA minted from the live issuer via the public self-serve path (no secret). Verifies offline against https://issuer.facet.llc/.well-known/jwks.json by the kid in the protected header. tier 'self' tokens carry a 1h TTL by design; re-run `node mint-live-kya.mjs` to mint a fresh, currently-valid one. Authenticity (signature + kid resolves in the live JWKS) holds for as long as that key is published.
